name: io.github.milisp.mcp-linker/solidping
title: SolidPing
description: Uptime checks, incidents and status pages from SolidPing

io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Open-source uptime monitoring (AGPL-3.0). List and create checks across 40+ check types, read results and incidents, and manage status pages and maintenance windows. Sign in with OAuth in your browser. A self-hosted instance serves the same MCP endpoint at /api/v1/mcp.
